entries.3bc58ac6b159e47c: A company that leases and sells temporary buildings and unit houses and their associated fixtures and furnishings, covering everything from manufacturing to transport, construction and repair.
entries.3fe4c6feb0aff2dc: Its basic policies are to contribute, through the operating lease system, to building a society in which environmental protection and economic growth coexist, and to promote a recycling operating lease system that cherishes the life of things, working to reduce waste and conserve resources; over the medium to long term, it says it aims to address labor shortages through greater operational efficiency and to secure earnings by turning outsourced construction work into leasable products. Its priority issues are order-taking activities that integrally emphasize the inventory status and delivery schedules of leased assets and profitability; building an organization through operational and business efficiency; and improving customer satisfaction by addressing occupational health and safety management and market needs for products.
